search_text: published ZDI-16-517 ZDI-CAN-3976 AlienVault Unified Security Management Remote Authentication Bypass Vulnerability 2016-09-19 10.0 ['AlienVault'] ['Unified Security Management'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication requirements on vulnerable installations of AlienVault Unified Security Manager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the logcheck function in session.inc. By providing a specific value as a user-agent, an attacker can bypass authentication to a number of pages. In addition to viewing information, it's possible to modify the application and achieve arbitrary code execution as root. AlienVault has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: AlienVault Unified Security Management Remote Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication requirements on vulnerable installations of AlienVault Unified Security Manager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the logcheck function in session.inc. By providing a specific value as a user-agent, an attacker can bypass authentication to a number of pages. In addition to viewing information, it's possible to modify the application and achieve arbitrary code execution as root.
